name: What defines modern landscape design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern landscape design emphasizes clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and the integration of sustainable materials. Key characteristics include open spaces, geometric forms, drought-tolerant plantings, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living areas. The focus is on functionality, simplicity, and creating a cohesive, sophisticated environment that complements contemporary architecture. It often incorporates elements like concrete, steel, natural stone, and muted color palettes to achieve a refined, uncluttered look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern landscape design features clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, sustainable materials, and a seamless indoor-outdoor connection.
